annotations.title: Email a quote to someone (asks first)

description: Prepares emailing a saved quote's public link to someone (usually the customer's client): returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is sent until confirm is called with it after the customer agrees. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

include_branding.description: Show the customer's own branding on the public page (default true).

quote.description: The quote number (or the quote id from its link).

recipient_email.description: Who to send it to (not the customer's own address).

name: email_quote

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.
